metadata.purpose: Watch the original source for missing timely values, then release it and fail or connect to a replacement.

conditions: Source values are forwarded unchanged before timeout.
First controls only the first value; positive each restarts after every source value.
The source is released before factory/fallback handoff; replacement values are not subject to another watchdog.

scope.parameters: first=absolute-5, each=none, binding=constant. Relative durations are integers 1..1000; absolute first time must be a future safe integer at subscription.
scope.callbacks: No user callback: the deprecated alias captures one constant Observable description.
scope.time: Supplied nonnegative safe integer now; deferred FIFO scheduler; current generation fires at or after due. Event/envelope times agree. Equal-time input order controls races; source arrival after a deadline can still win if timer delivery is late.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant reactions; synchronous callback outcomes are explicit microsteps. Ordered source teardown assumes source setup has returned.
exclusions: Synchronous source or fallback notification during subscription acquisition; source setup advancing the clock.
Nonpositive/fractional/nonfinite relative durations, expired absolute dates, synchronous queueScheduler, scheduler exceptions and platform timing precision.
Promise/Iterable conversions, invalid fallback inputs, factory reentrancy and throwing producer teardown.
Default TimeoutError prototype construction is assumed for the supplied factory outcome and checked independently natively.
Throwing observer/producer teardown, arbitrary reentrancy and universal infinite-trace liveness are not modeled.

initialization.sourceSubscription: No connection during construction. The first result subscription applies the profile-specific acquisition rule.

ownership.sharing: No implicit sharing or replay. Each result subscription owns its memory and resource generations; supplied producers may themselves be shared.
ownership.reset: Create fresh bookkeeping for each result connection. Payload objects are not cloned.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Ordered action words are model predictions, not executed effects. Callback invocation IDs correlate outcomes; they are not subscription IDs.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external reactions. Cancellation during synchronous multi-action delivery is characterized separately, not silently admitted into this profile.

inputs.description: First connection to this result execution.
A value from the currently owned source subscription.
Source failure with an opaque error value.
Consumer closes the result connection silently.
Current watchdog action executes at supplied now.

controls.description: See the typed state and named transitions for Source.
See the typed state and named transitions for Fallback.
Terminated; no owned subscriptions or retained values.

sources.purpose: Upstream scenario basis; test bodies inspected, not claimed to have been executed as the upstream suite.

rules.guard: first connection; initial deadline remains future and representable; supplied time is a nondecreasing safe integer
rules.nextState: Source with seen=0, lastValue=null and timer generation zero.
rules.explanation: The source is acquired before initial scheduling. This profile requires nonemitting, non-time-advancing source setup.

rules.guard: a current timer is active; supplied time is a nondecreasing safe integer
rules.nextState: Seen advances and no watchdog remains after the first value.
rules.explanation: A first-only deadline is removed by the first next. Relative each deadlines restart after each accepted value; source values do not inherit an absolute first deadline.

rules.guard: first-only watchdog was already satisfied; supplied time is a nondecreasing safe integer
rules.nextState: Seen advances and no watchdog remains after the first value.
rules.explanation: A first-only deadline is removed by the first next. Relative each deadlines restart after each accepted value; source values do not inherit an absolute first deadline.

rules.guard: source completes before watchdog delivery; supplied time is a nondecreasing safe integer
rules.explanation: Successful empty completion is not a timeout. A deadline alone is not a delivered event.

rules.guard: source fails before watchdog delivery; supplied time is a nondecreasing safe integer
rules.nextState: Closed error; no factory or fallback.
rules.explanation: Source errors preserve their payload and are not replaced by TimeoutError.

rules.guard: consumer closes while source owns the connection; supplied time is a nondecreasing safe integer
actions: cancel any current timer; emit nothing
rules.nextState: Closed cancel; no timeout factory or fallback.
rules.explanation: Cancellation owns teardown, not a terminal notification.

rules.guard: current timer generation fires at or after its deadline; supplied time is a nondecreasing safe integer
actions: cancel current timer during source finalization
rules.nextState: Fallback owns the result; the source and all watchdogs are released.
rules.explanation: RxJS 7.8.2 finalizes the source before building factory info: lastValue is null even after source values, while seen and meta survive.

rules.guard: notification belongs to the live fallback generation; supplied time is a nondecreasing safe integer
actions: forward exact fallback value without scheduling
rules.nextState: Same fallback token; source stays disconnected.
rules.explanation: Replacement values can differ in type from original source values and are not inspected.

rules.guard: notification belongs to live fallback; supplied time is a nondecreasing safe integer
rules.nextState: Closed complete; no source or timer exists.
rules.explanation: The replacement determines the final result lifetime after timeout.

rules.guard: notification belongs to live fallback; supplied time is a nondecreasing safe integer
rules.nextState: Closed error; no source or timer exists.
rules.explanation: The replacement determines the final result lifetime after timeout.

rules.guard: consumer closes the replacement connection; supplied time is a nondecreasing safe integer
rules.nextState: Closed cancel; do not release original source twice.
rules.explanation: The currently owned connection alone is cancelled.
